summary: The operator's rulings are recorded (dc25c31), so P5 wrote the guide's rules: twelve pages under docs/pages/guide/ in JenkinsPipelineUtils (b37b8ba). Each rule is an id-anchored MUST with its reason, stage labels and stage granularity are separate pages, and the pages carry the library decision test and the new-repo recipe. Every recipe is cut from four complete example Jenkinsfiles that `kc project lint` passes through the controller's full declarative linter, and check_site.py fails on any Groovy block typed straight into a page. `kc project test` is green. P3's reference snippets now follow the rules, the §5 a1 aac-tools template is assigned to P6 (P8 names it), and close-out D1/D2 record two readings of the rulings.
